summary: Lichen International Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an October 7, 2026 Share Transfer Agreement to divest its indirect wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary Bondly Enterprises Limited, which operates the professional education business through Xiamen Bondly. The transferor is Legend Consulting Limited; the transferee is an unaffiliated party with no prior relationship to the Company or its officers and directors. Consideration is HK$1.00 total, effectively no consideration. The Target reported significant losses and negative shareholders' equity as of August 31, 2026, driving the Board's decision to eliminate ongoing losses and focus on remaining operations. Watch execution risk and any residual liabilities retained.
